Evidence: Captain Amarinder Singh ne Punjab mein law and order ki complete failure ki baat ki hai, aur unhone kaha hai ki agar Prime Minister ko sirf 10km door se smooth passage nahi diya ja sakta, toh unhe office mein rehne ka koi haq nahi hai (Source 3). Lekin, is evidence mein gaddari ya kisi bhi tarah ke betrayal ka zikr nahi hai, aur na hi yeh claim ko support karta hai ki unki actions desh aur logo ke khilaf hain (Source 1, Source 2).
Justification: Retrieved evidence mein Captain Amarinder Singh ki taraf se gaddari ka koi bhi zikr nahi hai. Unhone law and order ki failure par criticism kiya hai, lekin ismein unki actions ko desh ya logo ke khilaf gaddari ke roop mein nahi dekha gaya hai. Isliye, yeh evidence claim ko directly contradict karta hai, jo gaddari ki baat karta hai.
